BiblicalUsage: God asks Job whether he has entered into the springs of the sea or walked in the search of the deep.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the question humbles me: the springs of the sea are hidden from me, and the God who made them knows them, and my wisdom ends where His depths begin.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
